task_instance: Run a minimal AnomalyGen SDG job (the skill's core deliverable): generate a small batch of synthetic anomaly images from a defect spec, i.e. a mode=inference_only run through Phases 0 and 2-7 producing results/<name>/original and searched image buckets with per_sample.csv / eval.log.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire pipeline runs only inside the GPU container image it declares (or a host with the cosmos-predict2 conda env active) and every phase performs CUDA GPU work (fine-tuning and diffusion-based synthetic image generation). This offline workstation has no CUDA GPU (no nvidia-smi, no /dev/nvidia* devices), no nvidia-container-toolkit, and although a docker CLI binary exists the docker daemon is not running and its socket is absent. The required container image would have to be pulled from a remote registry and Phase 0 would have to download roughly 40 GB of pretrained checkpoints from a model hub using an access token, all of which need network access that the air-gapped runtime forbids. Separately, the skill's bundled helper scripts referenced throughout (the scripts/utilities directory with check.sh, download_checkpoints.sh, prep_testcase.sh, run_sdg.sh, run_eval.sh, etc.) and the versions.yaml it cites are not present anywhere in the skill repository copy, so even the host path cannot be driven. No real deliverable (synthetic anomaly images or eval CSV/log files) can be produced; per the run rules I did not write any replacement script, stub, or fabricated image/score data.
evidence: Read SKILL.md: requires docker + nvidia-container-toolkit + a CUDA GPU, pulls the metropolis_sdg.paidf_anomalygen image declared in versions.yaml, Phase 0 needs a model-hub token to fetch ~40 GB checkpoints. Probed runtime from the work dir: 'command -v docker' -> /usr/bin/docker, but 'docker images' failed with 'failed to connect to the docker API at unix:///var/run/docker.sock ... no such file or directory' (daemon not running). 'command -v nvidia-smi' -> NO nvidia-smi; 'command -v nvidia-ctk' -> NO nvidia-ctk; 'ls /dev/nvidia*' -> NO /dev/nvidia*; 'command -v conda' -> NO conda (cosmos-predict2 env unavailable). Searched the skill repo at the r070 skill root: 'find' for a 'utilities' dir, versions.yaml, check.sh, download_checkpoints.sh, prep_testcase.sh returned nothing; the skill folder contains only SKILL.md, references/*.md, assets/ (ag_config.yaml, defect_spec_template.jsonl), config/, evals/, and card/signature files -- no executable pipeline scripts. No result files were generated; no result image buckets exist under the work directory.
